title: Finite-stage cancelled composition equation
statement: The cancelled composition equation holds for an integral constructible representative at every finite coefficient stage.

proof.text: At each finite integral input use zlStagePull_eq to form the explicit object transport stagePullIso: common pullback to the finite rational pullback and then to localization of integral pullback. The normalized common-stage compositor and the rational compositor normalization show that these transports conjugate common composition to localization of the integral compositor.

Use podIntegralPullbackComp_normalization to expand the integral compositor into completed inverse image and the three completion-unit comparisons. Naturality of the balanced derived comparison cancels the intermediate completion comparison. The scalar-only composition square then proves coherence of stageReindexIso.

Substitute integralRealizationAgreement at K for h and the composite, and at h-pullback K for g. Naturality of the g comparison moves the h object transport through it. Naturality of finite realization moves the localized integral compositor through the realization isomorphism. Apply the two preceding composition equations; cancel the intermediate finite realization isomorphism. Finally cancel the mapped h comparison to obtain the cancelled equation. The published common pullback object representation and the rational object formula identify the two transport domains; generic heterogeneous-equality lemmas remove and reinsert equality transports without unfolding the operation models.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15, explicit inverse-image formula; composition refinement using finite localization transports and completion-unit cancellation
